pulls.title: Changes for draft-parecki-oauth-jwt-dpop-grant-02
pulls.author: aaronpk
pulls.body:
Changes for -02.

## Fixes
- Step 4 compared `cnf.jkt` against a "`jkt` in the DPoP proof", which doesn't exist. The AS now computes the RFC 7638 thumbprint of the proof's `jwk` header and compares it to `cnf.jkt`, the same way a resource server checks a DPoP-bound access token (RFC 9449 §4.3 check 12, §6.1).
- Rewrote the abstract to describe binding of the assertion rather than the access token.
- Defined "DPoP-bound JWT assertion" and used it consistently; fixed the RFC 9449 title and README title.
- DPoP proof failures return RFC 9449 errors (`invalid_dpop_proof`, `use_dpop_nonce`); other failures return `invalid_grant`.
- Made Access Token Response a top-level section.
- Corrected section citations to RFC 9449, RFC 7523, and RFC 7521.

## Additions
- Requirements on the issuer of a DPoP-bound JWT assertion, with ID-JAG as the motivating use case.
- An AS supporting this grant MUST NOT accept a DPoP-bound assertion via `jwt-bearer`, plus security considerations for that downgrade.
- Guidance on DPoP nonces and replay, including not consuming the assertion's `jti` on a nonce retry.
- When bearer access tokens may be issued, refresh token binding per RFC 9449 §5, and related security considerations.
- Privacy Considerations.
- A complete, verifiable example appendix (signatures and thumbprint checked with openssl).

Builds cleanly with kramdown-rfc and xml2rfc; `make lint` passes.
